policies.intro: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") are a legally binding agreement between you ("User," "you," "your," which includes both Buyers and Sellers as defined below) and GemWorld, a company operating under the laws of India ("Company," "we," "us," "our," "Platform"), governing your access to and use of the GemWorld mobile application, associated website, and related services (collectively, the "Platform").
policies.secondaryIntro: By downloading, installing, registering on, accessing, or using the Platform in any manner, you unconditionally agree to be bound by these Terms, our Privacy Policy, our AML/KYC requirements, and any other policies referenced herein (together, the "Agreement"). If you do not agree, you must not access or use the Platform.

sections.title: Introduction and Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: If you use the Platform on behalf of a company, partnership, or other legal entity, you represent and warrant that you have the authority to bind that entity, and "you" refers to that entity as well as you personally.
We may modify these Terms at any time in accordance with Section 23. Continued use of the Platform after modifications constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.title: Definitions
paragraphs: In these Terms:
bullets: "Buyer" means a registered User who uses the Platform to purchase Diamonds.
"Seller" means a registered User, including manufacturers, miners, laboratories, wholesalers, and traders, who lists Diamonds for sale on the Platform.
"Diamond(s)" means natural diamonds and/or laboratory-grown/CVD (Chemical Vapour Deposition) or HPHT diamonds, whether loose or set, listed for sale on the Platform.
"Listing" means a Seller's offer to sell a specific Diamond or parcel of Diamonds on the Platform, including all accompanying descriptions, images, certificates, and pricing.

"Certifying Body" means an independent gemological grading laboratory (including but not limited to GIA, IGI, HRD, GCAL, or such other laboratory as we may recognize from time to time) that issues a Certificate for a Diamond.

"Certificate" or "Grading Report" means the report issued by a Certifying Body describing a Diamond's characteristics (carat, cut, color, clarity, origin — natural or lab-grown — and other attributes).
"Transaction" means any offer, order, sale, purchase, or exchange of Diamonds initiated, negotiated, or concluded using the Platform.

"Facilitation Services" means the payment facilitation, escrow, and logistics/shipping coordination services described in Sections 7 and 8, which we may provide directly or through Third-Party Providers.

"Third-Party Provider" means any independent payment processor, escrow agent, logistics carrier, insurer, customs broker, KYC/AML verification vendor, or Certifying Body engaged to support Transactions.
"Content" means all text, images, certificates, data, and other material uploaded, submitted, or transmitted by a User through the Platform.
"Vulnerability" means any bug, defect, exploit, security flaw, or unintended behavior of the Platform.

sections.title: Eligibility, Registration and Account Verification (KYC/AML)
paragraphs: Eligibility. You must be at least 18 years of age (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, if higher) and have the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts to register on the Platform. The Platform is intended for use by businesses (manufacturers, wholesalers, traders, laboratories, and professional buyers) and is a business-to-business (B2B) marketplace unless expressly stated otherwise.

KYC/AML Verification. Prior to activating trading privileges, every User must complete identity verification ("KYC") and, where applicable, business/entity verification, which may include government-issued identification, business registration documents, tax identification, beneficial ownership information, and bank/payment account verification. We reserve the right to engage Third-Party Providers to conduct KYC, sanctions screening (including against OFAC, UN, EU, and other applicable sanctions/watch lists), and anti-money-laundering ("AML") checks.
Ongoing Screening. We may re-verify Users periodically or on a risk basis and may suspend an account pending verification without liability to you.

Accuracy of Information. You represent that all information provided during registration and KYC is true, current, and complete, and you agree to promptly update it. Providing false, misleading, or incomplete information is a material breach of these Terms and may result in immediate suspension, forfeiture of pending Transactions, and reporting to relevant authorities.

Account Security. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials, API keys, and two-factor authentication devices, and for all activities that occur under your account, whether or not authorized by you, except to the extent such activity results solely from our gross negligence or willful misconduct. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use or suspected security breach.

One Account per User; No Impersonation. You may not create more than one account without our written permission, impersonate any person or entity, or misrepresent your affiliation with any person or entity.

sections.title: Nature of the Platform — Marketplace Intermediary, Not a Party to the Trade
paragraphs: The Platform is a technology marketplace that connects Buyers and Sellers of Diamonds and, where opted into by both parties, provides Facilitation Services. UNLESS EXPRESSLY STATED IN A SEPARATE WRITTEN AGREEMENT, THE COMPANY IS NOT A SELLER, BUYER, BROKER, AUCTIONEER, DEALER, APPRAISER, GRADER, OR AGENT OF ANY DIAMOND AND DOES NOT TAKE TITLE TO, POSSESSION OF (except as a logistics intermediary under Section 8), OR ANY OWNERSHIP INTEREST IN ANY DIAMOND LISTED OR TRADED ON THE PLATFORM.

Every Transaction is a direct contract of sale between the relevant Buyer and Seller. The Company is not a party to, and assumes no liability arising from, the underlying contract of sale, including its formation, performance, breach, quality, description, authenticity, delivery, or any dispute arising from it, except to the limited extent expressly set out in these Terms regarding our own Facilitation Services.
Nothing in these Terms creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, franchise, or employment relationship between the Company and any User.

sections.title: Listings, Certification Requirements and Diamond-Specific Representations
paragraphs: Seller Responsibility for Listings. Sellers are solely and exclusively responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and legality of every Listing, including carat weight, cut, color, clarity, treatment status, origin (natural or laboratory-grown/CVD/HPHT), provenance, and all Content uploaded.

Mandatory Independent Certification. Save where we expressly permit uncertified goods in a clearly labelled category, every Diamond (above such minimum carat weight as we specify from time to time) must be listed together with a valid, current Certificate from a Certifying Body recognized by the Platform. Sellers must disclose, prominently and unambiguously, whether a Diamond is natural or laboratory-grown, and any known treatments (e.g., HPHT annealing, irradiation, fracture filling, coating).

Kimberley Process and Conflict-Free Sourcing (Natural Diamonds). Sellers listing natural diamonds warrant that such diamonds are sourced, processed, and exported in compliance with the Kimberley Process Certification Scheme and applicable national implementing legislation, and where required, are accompanied by a valid Kimberley Process certificate and comply with the World Diamond Council System of Warranties. The Company does not independently verify Kimberley Process compliance and relies entirely on Seller warranties and Certifying Body/customs documentation.

Lab-Grown/CVD Disclosure. Sellers of laboratory-grown diamonds warrant compliance with all applicable disclosure laws in both the Seller's and (to the extent known) the Buyer's jurisdiction (for example, disclosure requirements comparable to the U.S. FTC Guides for the Jewelry Industry), including clear, unambiguous labelling of a Diamond's man-made origin at every stage — Listing, invoice, packaging, and accompanying Certificate.

No Independent Grading by the Company. THE COMPANY DOES NOT GRADE, APPRAISE, INSPECT, TEST, OR AUTHENTICATE ANY DIAMOND. We do not verify that a Certificate uploaded by a Seller is genuine, current, or actually corresponds to the physical Diamond offered, except where we expressly state that a specific verification step (e.g., certificate-number lookup with the Certifying Body's public database, where available) has been performed for a given Listing, and even then such verification is limited to what that lookup discloses.

Buyer Diligence. Buyers are responsible for reviewing the Certificate, Listing description, and (where offered) requesting independent verification, physical inspection, or a hold-for-inspection period before completing a Transaction. We strongly recommend Buyers independently verify any Certificate directly with the issuing Certifying Body prior to purchase.

Removal of Listings. We may, at our sole discretion and without liability, remove, suspend, or refuse any Listing that we reasonably believe is inaccurate, fraudulent, non-compliant with law, or in breach of these Terms, without any obligation to do so and without this creating any duty to monitor Listings generally.

sections.title: No Guarantee of Quality, Authenticity, or Payment
paragraphs: THE PLATFORM, ALL LISTINGS, AND ALL CONTENT ARE PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS," "AS AVAILABLE," AND "AS DESCRIBED BY THE SELLER" BASIS. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET OUT IN A SEPARATE WRITTEN GUARANTEE PROGRAM (IF ANY) THAT WE MAY OFFER FROM TIME TO TIME, THE COMPANY MAKES NO REPRESENTATION OR WARRANTY, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, REGARDING:
bullets: The quality, authenticity, grade, weight, origin, treatment status, or value of any Diamond;
The accuracy of any Certificate, Listing description, image, or other Content supplied by a Seller;
The creditworthiness, solvency, identity, or ability to perform of any Buyer or Seller;
The completion, timing, or successful settlement of any payment between Buyer and Seller;
Merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, title, or non-infringement of any Diamond or Content.
sections.closing: Reliance on Professional Verification. Where the Platform indicates that a Transaction has been reviewed by our professional/compliance team (e.g., document verification, sanctions screening, or facilitation of an independent inspection), that review is limited strictly to the specific matters we state were reviewed (such as KYC completion or document consistency checks) and is not, and must not be treated as, a certification, guarantee, or warranty of the Diamond's quality or of successful payment. Any statement by Company personnel regarding a Listing or User is for informational convenience only and does not modify these Terms unless made in a signed written amendment by an authorized officer of the Company. Payment Facilitation Is Not a Payment Guarantee. Provision of Facilitation Services (Section 7) does not constitute a guarantee by the Company that payment will be made, received, or cleared, nor a guarantee against chargebacks, reversals, insolvency of a User, or fraud by a counterparty, except to the extent we expressly agree to bear such risk under a specific, separately documented Escrow Protection Program. No Valuation Advice. Nothing on the Platform constitutes investment, valuation, or financial advice. Diamond prices are volatile and set solely by Sellers or by negotiation between Users.

sections.title: Payments, Fees and Escrow
paragraphs: Facilitation Role. Where a Transaction is routed through our payment Facilitation Services, funds are held and disbursed by us or by a licensed Third-Party Provider (e.g., a regulated escrow agent or payment institution) strictly as a limited-purpose paying agent for the Buyer and Seller, subject to the release conditions set out in the applicable Transaction flow (e.g., confirmed delivery, inspection period expiry, or dispute resolution outcome under Section 16).

Fees. We charge the fees disclosed in our then-current fee schedule (transaction fees, payment processing fees, currency conversion fees, and logistics fees where applicable), which are non-refundable except as expressly stated. We may change fees prospectively on notice.

Currency and FX. Cross-border Transactions may involve currency conversion performed by a Third-Party Provider at rates we do not control; we are not liable for FX losses, spreads, or delays caused by banking or payment intermediaries.

Taxes and Duties. Each User is solely responsible for determining, collecting, reporting, and remitting all taxes, duties, tariffs, and levies (including GST/VAT, customs duty, and income tax) arising from their Transactions. The Company is not responsible for tax withholding or filing on behalf of Users except where required by applicable law.

Chargebacks, Reversals and Fraud Losses. If a payment is reversed, charged back, or found to be fraudulent after funds have been disbursed to a Seller, the Seller agrees to promptly repay such amount to us on demand, and we may set off such amount against any other funds owed to that Seller.

No Client Money Trust Obligations Beyond Law. Where local law imposes safeguarding obligations on funds we hold (e.g., segregation requirements for licensed payment institutions), we will comply with those specific statutory obligations; nothing else in these Terms should be read as us assuming fiduciary duties beyond what is legally mandated.

sections.title: Logistics, Shipping, Customs, and Risk of Loss
paragraphs: Where the Platform coordinates shipping through Third-Party Providers (couriers, secure freight/vault-to-vault carriers, customs brokers, and insurers), we act solely as a coordination intermediary. Risk of loss or damage to a Diamond passes according to the shipping terms selected at checkout (e.g., Incoterms such as EXW, FOB, or CIF, as configured), and in the absence of a selection, risk passes to the Buyer upon handover to the first carrier.

Insurance. Sellers and Buyers are responsible for ensuring adequate transit insurance is purchased for the full declared value of a shipment. Where we offer an optional insurance add-on underwritten by a Third-Party Provider, our role is limited to facilitating the purchase of that policy; claims are made against, and paid by, the underwriter, not the Company.

Export/Import Compliance. Users are solely responsible for complying with export control laws, import restrictions, customs declarations, and Kimberley Process export/import documentation applicable to cross-border shipment of Diamonds. The Company is not responsible for shipments seized, delayed, or destroyed by customs or regulatory authorities.

Loss, Damage or Theft in Transit. Claims for loss, damage, or theft during transit must be pursued against the carrier and/or insurer in accordance with their respective terms; the Company's liability, if any, for coordination failures is capped as set out in Section 14.

sections.title: Acceptable Use, Prohibited Conduct and Platform Security (Anti-Abuse)
paragraphs: You agree that you will not, and will not permit or assist any third party to:
bullets: Access or attempt to access any part of the Platform, another User's account, or any data, in a manner not expressly permitted, including by circumventing authentication, rate limits, or access controls;

Probe, scan, or test the vulnerability of the Platform or any related system or network, or breach or circumvent any security or authentication measures, except under our formal Responsible Disclosure Program described in Section 10;

Exploit any bug, error, misconfiguration, race condition, pricing/inventory error, or unintended functionality (a "Loophole") for financial gain, to obtain goods, services, discounts, or data not properly authorized, or to cause harm to the Platform, the Company, or any User;
Use bots, scrapers, crawlers, or other automated means to access, extract data from, or transact on the Platform without our prior written consent;

Reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or otherwise attempt to derive source code, algorithms, or underlying data structures of the Platform, except to the extent such restriction is prohibited by applicable law;
Introduce viruses, malware, ransomware, or any other harmful code, or engage in denial-of-service or similar attacks;

Use the Platform for money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions evasion, trade-based fraud, or any other unlawful purpose, or to trade in conflict diamonds or Diamonds lacking legitimate provenance;
Engage in price manipulation, shill bidding, collusive Transactions, wash trading, or any conduct intended to artificially inflate or manipulate ratings, rankings, or prices;
Upload false, fraudulent, or misleading Listings, Certificates, or identity documents;

Circumvent the Platform to complete a Transaction off-platform in order to avoid fees, after having connected with a counterparty through the Platform, where doing so is prohibited by our then-current anti-circumvention policy;
Harass, defraud, threaten, or discriminate against another User.
sections.closing: Consequences of Breach. Any violation of Section 9 is a material breach entitling us, without notice and without liability to you, to: (a) immediately suspend or terminate your account and any pending Transactions; (b) withhold, freeze, reverse, or claw back any funds, fees, or benefits obtained through the violation; (c) pursue civil recovery of any resulting loss, and where a Loophole was exploited for financial gain, recovery of the full amount improperly obtained plus our investigation costs; (d) report the conduct to law enforcement, regulators, and financial-crime authorities; and (e) permanently bar you and any related entities from the Platform. Unjust Enrichment. Any benefit, discount, Diamond, or sum obtained through exploitation of a Loophole is deemed held on trust for the Company (or the affected User, as applicable) and must be returned or repaid immediately on demand, regardless of whether the exploited Loophole was known to us at the time.

sections.title: Responsible Disclosure of Vulnerabilities
paragraphs: We encourage good-faith security researchers to report Vulnerabilities to m.gemworld@gmail.com before exploiting, publicly disclosing, or otherwise using them. A report made in good faith, without accessing, modifying, or exfiltrating other Users' data beyond what is minimally necessary to demonstrate the issue, and without seeking to profit from the Vulnerability, will not be treated as a violation of Section 9, and we will not pursue legal action against a researcher who complies with this Section and our published disclosure policy (if any).

Any other discovery, use, or exploitation of a Vulnerability — including using it to complete Transactions, obtain funds or Diamonds, alter data, or access accounts — is a breach of Section 9 regardless of the discoverer's original intent, and will be pursued accordingly.

sections.title: Suspension and Termination
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate your account or restrict access to the Platform, at our sole discretion and without liability, immediately and without notice, where we reasonably suspect: breach of these Terms; fraudulent, unlawful, or abusive conduct; a KYC/AML/sanctions concern; a chargeback or payment dispute; or where required by law, a regulator, or a Third-Party Provider.
You may close your account at any time, subject to settlement of all pending Transactions, outstanding fees, and any open disputes.
Sections that by their nature should survive termination (including Sections 4, 6, 9, 12–20) survive termination of your account or these Terms.

sections.title: Disputes Between Buyers and Sellers
paragraphs: The Company is not responsible for resolving disputes between Buyers and Sellers regarding Diamond quality, description accuracy, delivery, or payment, except through the optional dispute-resolution assistance process described in Section 16, which is offered as a convenience and not as an admission of liability.

Where the Company offers a dispute-resolution or mediation facility, its decisions on release or return of escrowed funds/goods are administrative determinations made to operationalize the escrow arrangement and do not constitute a legal adjudication of the parties' rights; either party remains free to pursue its legal remedies against the other independently.

sections.title: Escrow and Transaction Dispute Process
paragraphs: If a Buyer disputes a Diamond's conformity to its Listing/Certificate within the applicable inspection window, the Buyer may raise a claim through the Platform, supported by evidence (e.g., an independent re-grading report from a Certifying Body).

Pending resolution, escrowed funds and/or the Diamond (if still within our logistics chain) may be held. The Company will make a reasonable, good-faith administrative determination based on the evidence submitted but does not guarantee any particular outcome and is not acting as an arbitrator, expert, or grading authority in doing so.
Either party may escalate an unresolved dispute to the dispute resolution mechanism in Section 19.

sections.title: Indemnification
paragraphs: You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the Company, its affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, liabilities, damages, losses, costs, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of or related to: (a) your breach of these Terms, including Section 9 (Prohibited Conduct); (b) your Listings, Content, or the Diamonds you sell, including any claim that a Diamond's description, Certificate, origin, or provenance is inaccurate or unlawful; (c) any Transaction you enter into with another User; (d) your violation of any applicable law, including AML, sanctions, export control, or consumer protection law; or (e) your infringement of any third party's intellectual property or other rights.

sections.title: Privacy and Data Protection

By using the Platform, you consent to such collection and use, including sharing KYC/AML data with Third-Party Providers and regulators as required by law.

We implement reasonable technical and organizational security measures appropriate to the sensitivity of the data we hold, but no system is completely secure, and we do not guarantee absolute security against unauthorized access.

sections.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: Primary Governing Law. Except as provided in the local mandatory law carve-out below, this Agreement is governed by the laws of India, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles.

Arbitration. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement or the Platform (excluding small claims eligible for a local small-claims court, and excluding claims for injunctive relief to protect intellectual property) shall be referred to and finally resolved by binding arbitration administered under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (India) under its rules then in force, seated in Mumbai, India, conducted in the English language, before one arbitrator. The arbitration award shall be final and binding, and judgment may be entered in any court of competent jurisdiction.

Local Mandatory Law Carve-Out. Where a User resides or is established in a jurisdiction whose mandatory consumer-protection, data-protection, or other non-waivable law grants that User rights or a local forum that cannot lawfully be displaced by the governing law and arbitration clauses above, such mandatory local law and forum apply solely to the extent required, and the remainder of this Agreement continues in full force.

Class Action Waiver. To the extent permitted by applicable law, disputes shall be resolved on an individual basis only, and you waive any right to participate in a class, collective, or representative action against the Company.

Injunctive Relief. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company may seek injunctive or equitable relief in any court of competent jurisdiction to prevent actual or threatened infringement, misappropriation, or violation of Section 9 (Prohibited Conduct) or its intellectual property rights.

You represent that you are not, and are not owned or controlled by, a person or entity subject to sanctions administered by the UN, OFAC, EU, UK, or other applicable authority, and that you will not use the Platform to transact with any such sanctioned person or in any sanctioned country.
Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption. You agree to comply with all applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws in connection with your use of the Platform.

Payment Services Regulation. Where our Facilitation Services require a local payment-institution, money-services-business, or escrow license in a given country, we will operate through appropriately licensed Third-Party Providers in that country, and our obligations are limited accordingly.
Diamond Trade Law. You agree to comply with all import/export, customs, and diamond-trade-specific laws (including Kimberley Process implementing legislation) applicable to your Transactions.

paragraphs: The Company shall not be liable for any failure or delay in performance resulting from causes beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, pandemics, war, civil unrest, government action, sanctions changes, customs delays, internet/telecommunications failures, or failures of Third-Party Providers.

sections.title: Open Items and Recommended Next Steps
paragraphs: The following open items are flagged for review by you and your legal counsel before launch. They are points that experience with marketplace platforms suggests are commonly missed, and they sit outside the numbered Sections above:
bullets: Confirm whether any Buyers could be classified as "consumers" rather than businesses in any target market — this changes which liability exclusions and cancellation/refund rights are enforceable (many countries mandate consumer rights that cannot be waived).

Confirm licensing requirements for holding or moving funds in each country you operate in (money transmitter, payment institution, or escrow licences) — operating without one is a criminal, not merely a contractual, risk.

Decide and document your Refund, Cancellation and Returns Policy — it is only referenced generally in Section 16 and needs concrete timelines (for example, inspection-window length and return-shipping cost allocation).
Confirm the standalone Privacy Policy addresses GDPR (if you have EU/UK users), India's DPDP Act, and other applicable data-protection regimes, as it is referenced throughout these Terms.
Draft a Community/Trust & Safety Policy covering fake-review handling, Seller rating manipulation, and counterfeit-certificate reporting.
Decide the anti-circumvention policy in detail (Section 9) — many marketplaces define a specific "no off-platform deals for N months after introduction" rule with liquidated damages.

Confirm insurance coverage: whether the Company needs its own contingent cargo/marine insurance, professional indemnity (E&O) insurance, and cyber-liability insurance, given the liability caps in Section 14.
Age and eligibility: if you ever allow individual (non-business) consumer Buyers, add jewellery-specific consumer protections (for example, cooling-off periods in some countries).

Confirm Google Play policy compliance separately — the Play Store has its own Payments Policy, Financial Services requirements, and User Data policy that may restrict how escrow and payment facilitation are described in-app, independently of these Terms.
Set up a formal incident-response and breach-notification procedure (many jurisdictions impose statutory notification deadlines after a data breach, separate from anything in these Terms).
Consider a separate, shorter Seller Agreement with commercial terms (fees, exclusivity, minimum listing standards) rather than folding everything into consumer-facing Terms.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your data
policies.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how GemWorld ("Platform", "we", "us") collects, uses, stores, and shares personal information when you use our marketplace for natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, bullion, and related services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide and information generated through your use of the Platform.
bullets: Account details: name, email, phone, password, business name, GST/tax IDs, and KYC documents where required.
Profile and preferences: saved searches, wishlist items, communication preferences, and language/currency settings.
Transaction data: orders, bids, invoices, shipping addresses, payment confirmation metadata, and dispute records.
Seller data: listings, certifications, inventory, payout details, and seller performance metrics.
Device and usage data: IP address, device type, browser, app version, pages viewed, and approximate location derived from IP.
Support and AI chatbot conversations used to resolve issues and improve assistance (see Terms §13).
Cookies and similar technologies as described in our Cookies Policy.

sections.title: Why We Collect Information
paragraphs: We use personal information only for legitimate marketplace purposes.
bullets: Create and secure accounts; verify identity for high-value orders or seller onboarding.
Process orders, auctions, payments, refunds, and deliveries.
Display listings, enable comparisons, inquiries, messaging, and reviews.
Detect fraud, fake bidding, money-laundering risks, and policy abuse.
Provide customer support and improve product discovery and AI assistance.
Send transactional notices (order status, bidding, security alerts) and, where permitted, marketing communications you can opt out of.
Comply with tax, customs, sanctions, and other legal obligations.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: GemWorld and its partners use essential, analytics, and marketing cookies to operate the site, measure performance, and personalize content. Details and control options are in the Cookies Policy. Disabling essential cookies may limit checkout, login, or security features.

sections.title: Payment Security
paragraphs: Payment card and UPI processing is handled by approved payment gateways. GemWorld does not store full card numbers or CVV on its servers. We receive limited confirmation data (status, reference IDs, last digits where provided) needed to fulfill orders and prevent fraud. High-value transactions may require additional identity or source-of-funds verification.

sections.title: Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share information only as needed to operate the marketplace:
bullets: With the other party to a transaction (buyer or seller) for order fulfillment, shipping, and dispute resolution.
With payment processors, logistics partners, certification labs (when you request verification services), and cloud/IT providers under contracts.
With regulators, courts, or law enforcement when legally required.
In connection with a merger, acquisition, or corporate reorganization, subject to appropriate safeguards.
sections.closing: Buyers and sellers must not move transactions off-platform. GemWorld is not responsible for privacy or losses from off-platform dealings.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable Indian law (including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, where applicable), you may request:
bullets: Access to personal data we hold about you.
Correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
Withdrawal of consent for optional processing (e.g. marketing).
Deletion or restriction where legally available, subject to retention needed for transactions, disputes, fraud prevention, and legal compliance.
Grievance redressal via m.gemworld@gmail.com or the Help Center.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain account and transaction records for as long as your account is active and thereafter as required for tax, accounting, dispute, AML, and legal purposes. Chatbot logs and support tickets are retained for service improvement and abuse detection, then deleted or anonymized according to our retention schedule. Inactive accounts may be archived or deleted after notice where practicable.

sections.title: Security & Updates
paragraphs: We use administrative, technical, and organizational measures appropriate to the sensitivity of jewelry and diamond marketplace data. No method of transmission is fully secure; please protect your credentials and never share passwords or card numbers in chat.
We may update this Policy by posting a revised version. Continued use of GemWorld after updates means acceptance of the revised Policy.

policies.secondaryIntro: By creating an account, browsing, purchasing, listing, bidding, or continuing to use GemWorld after updates, you accept this Policy. Please also read our Terms & Conditions and Cookies Policy.

policies.title: Refund & Return Policy
policies.subtitle: Returns, custom items, auctions, and refunds
policies.intro: This Policy explains when buyers may return products purchased on GemWorld and how refunds are processed for natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, bullion, and accessories.

sections.title: Return Period
paragraphs: Unless a listing states otherwise, eligible standard (non-auction, non-custom) purchases may be returned within 7 days of delivery, provided the request is submitted through official GemWorld channels with order details and supporting photos where relevant.
Return windows for watches, bullion, or special collections may differ and will be shown on the listing or checkout page.

sections.title: Eligible Products
paragraphs: Returns are generally accepted when all of the following apply:
bullets: The product is unused, unworn, unaltered, and in original condition.
Original packaging, tags, seals, and grading certificates / authenticity documents are included.
The product matches the order and is not marked non-returnable.
The buyer followed inspection guidance and reported issues promptly.

sections.title: Non-Returnable Products
paragraphs: Unless defective or required by law, the following are typically non-returnable:
bullets: Customized, engraved, resized, or made-to-order jewelry.
Products with broken seals, missing certificates, or signs of wear or alteration.
Items explicitly marked as final sale or non-returnable on the listing.
Digital services, insurance add-ons, or platform fees once consumed.
Bullion where market price movement or opened packaging makes resale impractical under listing terms.

sections.title: Customized Jewelry
paragraphs: Customized or engraved items are made to buyer specifications and are not eligible for return or refund unless they arrive defective, damaged in transit, or materially different from the approved customization brief. Buyers must confirm designs, sizes, metals, and engravings before production begins.

sections.title: Auction Purchases
paragraphs: Winning auction bids are binding. Auction purchases are generally final once payment is completed, except where the item is significantly not as described, counterfeit, or arrives damaged with supporting evidence. Failure to pay within 48 hours may lead to bid cancellation, temporary account block, and other penalties under the Auction Policy.

sections.title: Refund Timeline
paragraphs: After GemWorld and/or the seller approve a return and receive the product in acceptable condition (and complete any authenticity check), refunds are initiated to the original payment method where possible.

Bank, card, and UPI providers typically post refunds within 5–10 business days after initiation; exact timing depends on the payment provider. Marketplace fees may be adjusted according to the reason for return.

sections.title: Damaged or Incorrect Items
paragraphs: Inspect packages on delivery. If an item is damaged, incomplete, or incorrect, report it promptly via the Help Center with photos of the packaging, product, and certificate. Do not discard packaging until the claim is resolved.

Approved damaged or incorrect shipments may be replaced or refunded. GemWorld may cancel suspicious orders or claims. Off-platform settlements are not supported and are undertaken at the user’s own risk.

sections.title: Bullion & Market Notes
paragraphs: Bullion prices may change due to market fluctuations. Refunds for eligible bullion returns may reflect listing terms regarding price movement, packaging integrity, and assay/certificate requirements. Continued use of GemWorld means acceptance of updates to this Policy.

policies.secondaryIntro: All prices, weights, measurements, and numerical values on listings are approximate and as accurate as reasonably possible. Natural diamonds and gemstones may have natural variations; lab-grown diamonds may have slight manufacturing variations. Product images are for reference; colors may vary by screen.

policies.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
policies.subtitle: Processing, insurance, customs, and delays
policies.intro: This Policy describes how GemWorld orders for diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, and bullion are processed, insured, and delivered.

sections.title: Shipping Methods
paragraphs: Orders ship via GemWorld-approved courier partners suitable for high-value goods. Available methods (standard, express, or insured specialty) appear at checkout and may vary by product category, seller location, and destination.

sections.title: Processing Time
paragraphs: Sellers typically process confirmed, paid orders within 1–3 business days, excluding customization lead times. High-value orders may be held pending identity verification. Auction wins are processed after payment clears within the required 48-hour window.

sections.title: Delivery Estimates
paragraphs: Domestic Indian deliveries commonly take 2–7 business days after dispatch, depending on destination and courier. International timelines vary and may include customs clearance. Estimates shown at checkout are not guarantees.

sections.title: Insurance
paragraphs: Eligible high-value shipments may include transit insurance arranged by the seller, GemWorld, or the courier as indicated at checkout. Coverage terms, deductibles, and claim procedures follow the insurer’s policy. Buyers should keep packaging and claim evidence.

sections.title: Customs Duties & Taxes
paragraphs: For cross-border shipments, buyers are responsible for customs duties, GST/VAT, brokerage, and import charges unless the listing expressly states otherwise. Incorrect addresses or refused customs clearance may delay delivery or incur return costs.

sections.title: Lost Packages
paragraphs: If tracking shows no movement beyond the expected window, contact support with the order ID. GemWorld will coordinate with the seller and courier. Proven loss under insured transit may result in replacement or refund per insurance and listing terms.

sections.title: Delivery Delays
paragraphs: Delays from customs inspections, weather, natural disasters, courier disruptions, incorrect addresses, or buyer unavailability do not constitute a Platform breach. Provide accurate addresses and be available for OTP or ID checks common for jewelry deliveries.
Buyers and sellers must complete transactions on GemWorld. The Platform is not responsible for shipping arranged outside the Platform.

policies.secondaryIntro: Shipping delays caused by customs, weather, courier capacity, strikes, or force majeure are outside GemWorld’s direct control. Users are responsible for applicable taxes, duties, and import charges where required.

policies.title: Seller Policy
policies.subtitle: Listing rules, authenticity, and penalties
policies.intro: This Seller Policy sets rules for businesses and individuals listing products on GemWorld. Sellers must provide genuine products, accurate information, and professional fulfillment for diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, bullion, and accessories.

sections.title: Listing Products
paragraphs: Sellers must keep inventory accurate and publish complete listings with category, specifications, pricing, shipping terms, and return notes where applicable.
bullets: Use clear titles and truthful descriptions for natural vs lab-grown diamonds, treatments, origin, and metal purity.
Disclose approximate weights, measurements, and prices as accurately as reasonably possible.
Upload real product images; stock or borrowed images are prohibited unless clearly disclosed and permitted.
Update or delist items that are sold, reserved, or no longer available.

sections.title: Genuine Products Only
paragraphs: Only authentic, legally owned goods may be sold. Stolen, conflict, or illegally sourced merchandise is forbidden. Natural diamond sellers represent that goods are not knowingly conflict diamonds and, where applicable, comply with Kimberley Process or equivalent requirements.

sections.title: Certifications
paragraphs: Where a listing references GIA, IGI, or other lab reports, certificates, hallmarking, or watch authenticity papers, sellers must provide matching documentation and ship certificates with the product. Misrepresenting grading, treatment, or authenticity is grounds for immediate action.

sections.title: Shipping Responsibilities
paragraphs: Sellers must pack securely, ship within stated processing times, use approved methods for high-value goods, provide tracking, and cooperate on insurance claims. Delays outside the seller’s control (customs, weather, courier issues) should be communicated promptly to the buyer through Platform channels.

sections.title: No Counterfeit Goods
paragraphs: Counterfeit jewelry, fake certificates, replica watches sold as genuine, and adulterated bullion are strictly prohibited. GemWorld may require third-party verification and may permanently remove accounts involved in counterfeits.

sections.title: No Off-Platform Sales
paragraphs: Sellers must not solicit buyers to complete payment, shipping, or after-sales deals outside GemWorld after a Platform introduction. Circumventing fees or moving deals off-platform is prohibited. GemWorld is not responsible for any off-platform transaction.

sections.title: Seller Penalties
paragraphs: Penalties may apply for fake listings, late shipments without cause, excessive cancellations, review manipulation, auction abuse, non-genuine goods, or policy breaches:
bullets: Warning and mandatory listing corrections.
Temporary listing freeze or search demotion.
Fee recovery, hold on payouts, or order cancellation.
Suspension or permanent removal of the seller account.
sections.closing: Continued use of GemWorld as a seller constitutes acceptance of updates to this Policy and related marketplace rules.

policies.secondaryIntro: Violations may result in listing removal, fee recovery, reduced visibility, temporary suspension, or permanent account removal. GemWorld may cancel suspicious listings or orders at any time.

policies.title: Buyer Policy
policies.subtitle: Verification, payment, and auction obligations
policies.intro: This Buyer Policy explains buyer responsibilities when shopping, bidding, and communicating on GemWorld.

sections.title: Account Verification
paragraphs: Buyers must be at least 18 years old (or have legal capacity), provide accurate registration details, and keep contact information current. GemWorld may request KYC or additional verification for high-value purchases, international orders, or risk signals.

sections.title: Payment Responsibility
paragraphs: Buyers must use legitimate payment methods they are authorized to use, complete payment for confirmed orders and auction wins, and pay applicable taxes, duties, and import charges where required. Chargebacks filed in bad faith may lead to account restrictions.

sections.title: Inspect Products
paragraphs: Review listing details, certificates, and images before purchase. On delivery, inspect the product, packaging, and documents. Report damage, shortage, or material discrepancies promptly through official support channels with evidence.

Natural diamonds and gemstones may show natural variations; lab-grown diamonds may have slight manufacturing variations; screen colors may differ from physical appearance. These alone are not defects.

sections.title: Auction Obligations
paragraphs: Every bid is binding. Winning bidders must pay within 48 hours (1–2 days). Failure to pay may result in bid cancellation, temporary block, and further penalties under the Auction Policy.

sections.title: Respect Marketplace Rules
paragraphs: Buyers must not harass sellers or staff, submit fake reviews, attempt to buy stolen or restricted goods, scrape data, or complete transactions outside the Platform. Off-platform deals are unsupported and at the buyer’s sole risk.
Continued use of GemWorld means acceptance of updated policies.

policies.secondaryIntro: Fake bids, fraudulent activity, and account misuse are prohibited. High-value orders may require identity verification. The Platform may suspend or permanently remove accounts that violate policies.

policies.title: Auction Policy
policies.subtitle: Bidding, 48-hour payment, and fake bids
policies.intro: This Auction Policy governs timed bidding events on GemWorld for eligible diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, bullion, and other catalog items.

sections.title: Bidding Rules
paragraphs: Only verified users may bid. Bids must meet minimum increments and any reserve rules shown on the auction page. Bids are irrevocable except in exceptional cases determined by GemWorld (for example, clear technical error).
bullets: Do not use multiple accounts to influence an auction.
Do not coordinate with sellers or other bidders to manipulate outcomes.
Review product details, certificates, and approximate specs before bidding.

sections.title: Winning Bidder Obligations
paragraphs: The highest valid bidder at close wins, subject to reserve and Platform verification. The winner must complete checkout, provide a valid shipping address, and cooperate with any required identity checks.

sections.title: Payment Within 48 Hours
paragraphs: Full payment for the winning bid (plus applicable taxes, fees, and shipping shown at checkout) is due within 48 hours of auction close unless a listing states a shorter window. Orders are not processed until payment is verified.

sections.title: Temporary Block for Non-Payment
paragraphs: Failure to pay on time may result in cancellation of the win, temporary bidding or account blocks, loss of auction privileges, and, for repeated offenses, permanent removal. Sellers may be permitted to re-list the item.

sections.title: Fake Bidding Prohibited
paragraphs: Shill bidding, fake bids, bid retraction abuse, collusion, and any activity intended to artificially inflate prices are prohibited and may lead to immediate suspension and legal referral where appropriate.

sections.title: Auction Cancellation
paragraphs: GemWorld may cancel or suspend an auction for fraud, listing errors, product unavailability, technical failures, seller violations, or suspicious activity. Where an auction is cancelled before payment completion, winning obligations are released. Material policy updates apply on continued use of the Platform.

policies.secondaryIntro: Winning auction bidders must pay within 1–2 days (48 hours). Fake bids, fraudulent activity, and account misuse are prohibited.

policies.title: Payment Policy
policies.subtitle: Methods, verification, taxes, and chargebacks
policies.intro: This Payment Policy describes how buyers pay for marketplace and auction purchases on GemWorld and how payment issues are handled.

sections.title: Accepted Payment Methods
paragraphs: Accepted methods may include UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, approved wallets, bank transfer, and other gateways enabled for your region. Availability can vary by order value and risk checks. Prices are primarily shown in Indian Rupees (INR) unless otherwise stated.

sections.title: Payment Verification
paragraphs: Orders and auction wins are processed only after payment is successfully verified. GemWorld or its payment partners may request additional verification (OTP, 3-D Secure, KYC, or source-of-funds) especially for high-value jewelry, diamond, or bullion orders.

sections.title: Failed Payments
paragraphs: If payment fails, expires, or is reversed before confirmation, the order may be cancelled and inventory released. For auctions, failed or incomplete payment within 48 hours is treated as non-payment under the Auction Policy.

sections.title: Currency Conversion
paragraphs: If your bank or card issues in a currency other than the checkout currency, your provider’s conversion rates and fees apply. Bullion and some precious-metal linked prices may change with market fluctuations before payment is captured.

sections.title: Taxes
paragraphs: Applicable GST and other taxes may be calculated at checkout. Import duties and destination taxes for cross-border deliveries are generally the buyer’s responsibility unless expressly stated otherwise on the listing.

sections.title: Chargebacks
paragraphs: Contact GemWorld support before filing a chargeback so we can investigate. Chargebacks filed in bad faith, or to avoid valid auction obligations, may result in account suspension or permanent removal. Legitimate payment disputes are reviewed under the Contact & Dispute Policy.
Continued use of GemWorld after updates constitutes acceptance of this Payment Policy.

policies.secondaryIntro: High-value orders may require identity verification. Users are responsible for applicable taxes, duties, and import charges where required.

policies.title: Product Listing Policy
policies.subtitle: Accurate descriptions, images, and certifications
policies.intro: This Policy sets content standards for every GemWorld listing across natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, bullion, and accessories.

sections.title: Accurate Descriptions
paragraphs: Listings must clearly state product type, key attributes (shape, carat/weight, color, clarity, cut, metal, purity, brand, movement, etc.), treatments, origin where claimed, and whether a diamond is natural or lab-grown.

sections.title: Real Images
paragraphs: Images must depict the actual item offered for sale (or a clearly labeled representative pair/melee sample where industry practice allows). Do not use another seller’s photos, watermarked lab images as if they were yours without rights, or edited images that hide damage or misrepresent color.
Product images are for reference; colors may vary by screen. Natural and lab-grown materials may show slight natural or manufacturing variations.

sections.title: Approximate Weights & Prices
paragraphs: All prices, weights, measurements, and other numerical values are approximate and as accurate as reasonably possible. Sellers must not knowingly inflate carat weight, understate inclusions, or post bait prices they will not honor. Bullion prices may change due to market fluctuations; update live pricing promptly.

sections.title: Certifications
paragraphs: When certifications are claimed, provide report numbers and matching documents. Do not invent grading reports or reuse a certificate for a different stone. Watches and jewelry authenticity papers must match the item shipped.

sections.title: No Misleading Information
paragraphs: Prohibited practices include false scarcity claims, undisclosed treatments, counterfeit branding, fake reviews, and off-platform contact baiting. GemWorld may cancel suspicious listings or orders and suspend accounts that violate this Policy. Continued use means acceptance of updates.

policies.secondaryIntro: Sellers must provide genuine products and accurate information. Misleading listings may be removed and accounts restricted.

policies.title: Cookies Policy
policies.subtitle: Essential, analytics, and marketing cookies
policies.intro: This Cookies Policy explains how GemWorld uses cookies and similar technologies on our websites and apps.

sections.title: Essential Cookies
paragraphs: These cookies are required for core functionality such as login sessions, security, fraud prevention, checkout, load balancing, and remembering critical preferences. The Platform may not work correctly if essential cookies are blocked.

sections.title: Analytics Cookies
paragraphs: Analytics cookies help us understand how users browse categories (diamonds, gemstones, jewelry, watches, bullion), which features are used, and where errors occur so we can improve performance and product discovery. Data is typically aggregated or pseudonymized where practicable.

sections.title: Marketing Cookies
paragraphs: Where permitted, marketing cookies measure campaign effectiveness and may help show relevant marketplace promotions. You can opt out of non-essential marketing cookies through browser settings or in-product preference controls when available.

sections.title: User Control
paragraphs: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies. Managing cookies at the browser or device level may log you out or limit saved carts and preferences. For privacy requests related to cookie-derived data, contact m.gemworld@gmail.com or use the Help Center.

policies.secondaryIntro: Continued use of the Platform after updates means acceptance of this Policy. See also our Privacy Policy.

policies.title: Intellectual Property Policy
policies.subtitle: Logos, images, trademarks, and infringement reports
policies.intro: This Policy protects GemWorld’s brand and content and explains how users may report intellectual property concerns.

sections.title: Logos
paragraphs: The GemWorld name, logos, and brand assets may not be used without prior written permission, except for factual references that do not imply endorsement or partnership.

sections.title: Images
paragraphs: Platform imagery, UI graphics, and marketing visuals are protected. Seller product photos remain the seller’s responsibility; by uploading, sellers warrant they have rights to use those images and grant GemWorld a license to display them for marketplace operations and promotion.

sections.title: Designs
paragraphs: Software, page layouts, filters, comparison tools, and original design systems on GemWorld are protected by copyright and related rights. Copying, scraping, or reverse engineering beyond what law permits is prohibited.

sections.title: Trademarks
paragraphs: Third-party trademarks (for example watch brands or lab names) appear for identification of genuine goods. Unauthorized use of another’s trademark in a listing to sell counterfeit or unrelated goods is forbidden.

sections.title: Copyright
paragraphs: Text, catalogs, and original content published by GemWorld are protected. Users must not republish Platform content as their own or remove proprietary notices.

sections.title: Reporting Infringement
paragraphs: If you believe content on GemWorld infringes your IP rights, email m.gemworld@gmail.com with:
bullets: Your contact details and proof of rights ownership.
URLs or listing IDs of the allegedly infringing material.
A good-faith statement that use is not authorized.
sections.closing: GemWorld may remove content, cancel listings, or suspend accounts involved in infringement. Continued use accepts policy updates.

policies.title: Contact & Dispute Policy
policies.subtitle: Support channels and dispute resolution
policies.intro: This Policy explains how to reach GemWorld support and how buyer–seller disputes are handled on the marketplace.

sections.title: Contact Methods
paragraphs: You can contact us through:
bullets: In-app / website Help Center (buyer or seller help tickets).
Email: m.gemworld@gmail.com
Order, inquiry, and chat tools inside your GemWorld account for transaction-specific issues.
sections.closing: Include order IDs, listing links, and photos when reporting shipping, authenticity, or quality issues.

sections.title: Complaint Process
paragraphs: Submit a clear description of the issue, desired resolution, and evidence. GemWorld aims to acknowledge support tickets promptly and may request additional documents (certificates, KYC, courier reports). Abusive or fraudulent complaints may lead to account action.

sections.title: Buyer–Seller Disputes
paragraphs: Most issues should first be discussed through Platform messaging. If unresolved, either party may escalate via the Help Center. Typical disputes include non-delivery, item not as described, damaged goods, missing certificates, payment confirmation problems, and auction non-payment.

sections.title: Platform Decision Process
paragraphs: GemWorld may review listing data, chat logs, payment records, tracking, and certificates. Outcomes may include return authorization, partial or full refund, order cancellation, payout holds, listing removal, temporary blocks, or permanent account removal for policy violations (including fake bidding or counterfeit goods).

Platform decisions on marketplace disputes are made in good faith under our policies and applicable law. Mandatory consumer rights under Indian law are not waived. These Terms-related policies are governed by the laws of India as stated in the Terms & Conditions.
Continued use of GemWorld means acceptance of updated Contact & Dispute Policy terms.

policies.secondaryIntro: Buyers and sellers must not complete transactions outside the Platform. GemWorld is not responsible for any off-platform transaction or related dispute.
